description: This file defines the PhotoTask class in an Android application responsible for managing download and decode tasks for photos, including task initialization, managing thread references, and coordinating with a PhotoManager singleton.

classes.name: PhotoTask
classes.description: Manages download and decode operations for a photo, encapsulating relevant state, weak references to the view, and coordination with a PhotoManager singleton.

methods.name: PhotoTask
methods.description: Constructor that initializes download and decode runnables and sets up the PhotoManager singleton.

methods.name: initializeDownloaderTask
methods.description: Initializes the task with PhotoManager, PhotoView, and cache flag, setting up URL, weak reference to the view, and target dimensions.

methods.name: getByteBuffer
methods.description: Returns the byte buffer of the image.

methods.name: recycle
methods.description: Prepares the PhotoTask for reuse by clearing references to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: getTargetWidth
methods.description: Returns the target width for the image.

methods.name: getTargetHeight
methods.description: Returns the target height for the image.

methods.name: isCacheEnabled
methods.description: Identifies whether caching is enabled for this task.

methods.name: getImageURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the image to download.

methods.name: setByteBuffer
methods.description: Sets the image byte buffer.

methods.name: handleState
methods.description: Delegates the current task state to the PhotoManager.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the decoded Bitmap image.

methods.name: getHTTPDownloadRunnable
methods.description: Returns the Runnable responsible for downloading the image.

methods.name: getPhotoDecodeRunnable
methods.description: Returns the Runnable responsible for decoding the image.

methods.name: getPhotoView
methods.description: Returns the PhotoView associated with this task, or null if garbage collected.

methods.name: getCurrentThread
methods.description: Returns the Thread this task is currently running on, synchronized with PhotoManager.

methods.name: setCurrentThread
methods.description: Sets the current thread for this task, synchronized with PhotoManager.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the Bitmap image after decoding.

methods.name: setDownloadThread
methods.description: Associates a download thread with this task.

methods.name: handleDownloadState
methods.description: Converts and delegates download state to PhotoManager.

methods.name: setImageDecodeThread
methods.description: Associates a decode thread with this task.

methods.name: handleDecodeState
methods.description: Converts and delegates decode state to PhotoManager.
